messages:
Lena (Sales): Heads-up — BlueRidge Labs signed last night. CTO: Priya, Platform lead: Omar. They want private deployment (VPC peering) + SCIM/Okta SSO. Committed to dedicated capacity starting in ~5 weeks. Baseline 2.2M tokens/mo, expected peak 4.8M. Renewal in 10 months; procurement cadence is slow in their org (flagging renewal watch if invoicing slips >45 days). Passing to CS for onboarding and to Eng/Support for infra/runbook prep.

Ravi (CS): Taking this. Ill own kickoff and first 30 days. Can we get: billing contact, list of priority API flows (normal + edge/error), and any regulatory requirements (they mentioned HIPAA-adjacent workloads).

Lena (Sales): Billing contact is Ava (RevOps) on cc. Priority flows: 1) realtime chat agent (low-latency, short prompts) 2) batch embeddings for search (larger payloads) 3) classification webhook. Also flagged: audit logs retention and export. Link to sample prompts: https://drive.redwood/blueridge-sample.

Nina (Eng): Ill do the VPC/peering & SSO feasibility check. ETA: 4 business days for checklist + risk notes. Need: test CIDR for peering, proxy/firewall egress rules, contact for their infra (Omar). Also what GPU tier they expect? (A100 vs A10) Canary strategy suggested for initial traffic.

Marco (Support): Ill draft support runbook and onboarding playbook. Quick checklist Im starting with:
```
preflight:
  - verify peering connectivity
  - validate SSO SCIM sync
monitoring:
  - p95 latency < 350ms
  - 5xx rate < 0.5%
escalation:
  - cs-oncall -> eng-oncall -> infra-owner
```
Will push first version to the shared doc by EOD Fri.

Ava (RevOps): Ill expedite billing & PO lane. Procurement asked for SOC2 + data processing addendum; Ive requested legal checklist. PO ETA currently 3 weeks, but Ill update if procurement needs longer.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu 9:30am PDT  "BlueRidge onboarding intake" (invitees: Lena, Ravi, Nina, Marco, Priya).

Ravi (CS): Setting up a kickoff doc w/ sections: "owners & due dates", "success criteria", "risk register", "enablement materials". Proposed owners: Ravi (CS) overall, Nina (Eng) infra precheck, Marco (Support) runbook, Ava (RevOps) billing. Proposed deadlines: infra precheck in 4bd, runbook draft in 3bd, kickoff Thu.

Lena (Sales): Added model details: running redwood/opt-13b-quant; checkpoint ~12GB post-quant. Concurrency estimate: 35 rps during peak. Also requested cold-start latency targets from Eng.

Nina (Eng): Noted. Well need model memory footprint + expected max sequence length to size GPU. Lena  can you confirm seq len?

Lena (Sales): Typical seq len ~512 tokens for chat. Batch jobs up to 4096 tokens for embeddings. Added to the doc.

Marco (Support): Quick question on enablement: does the customer want a runbook walkthrough with their oncall? I recommend a joint drill (simulated latency spike + failover) early in week 2.

Ravi (CS): Yes thats on the plan. Also we need to capture customer success metrics up front: adoption targets (calls/min), LTV triggers, and a small NPS/qual feedback touchpoint after 30 days. Who owns the feedback capture?

Ava (RevOps): I can own the billing & renewal watch. Ill add a renewal-risk tag to the account if PO is delayed >45 days. Also will collect procurement SLAs and share.

Lena (Sales): FYI they requested 24/7 support add-on; will discuss in kickoff. Could impact SLA and cost.

Nina (Eng): For the precheck Ill include recommended canary ramp and a fallback model policy (hosted compat) in case dedicated slots are delayed.

Marco (Support): Draft runbook link added. I included troubleshooting commands and sample log grep for slow responses. Also adding escalation matrix with contact rotation.

Ravi (CS): Summarizing next steps that Ill paste into the kickoff doc:
- Owners: Ravi (CS lead), Nina (Eng infra precheck), Marco (Support runbook), Ava (RevOps billing), Lena (Sales handoff)
- Deliverables & ETA: infra precheck (4bd), runbook draft (3bd), kickoff Thu 9:30am PDT
- Success criteria: <350ms p95 for chat, <0.5% 5xx, onboarding sign-offs from Priya/Omar, PO in place within 45 days or escalation to AM/RevOps
- Enablement: schedule runbook drill wk2, collect 30d feedback + NPS touchpoint

Lena (Sales): :thumbsup: Ill follow up post-kickoff with any contract quirks. If procurement pushes past 45 days Ill raise to AM immediately.

Marco (Support): Final note  Ill include a short "what to log" snippet for their engineers to attach to app logs (trace_id, model_id, latency_ms). Saves time during triage.

Ravi (CS): Thanks all. Ill update this thread after kickoff with the finalized owners & runbook link. Close for now.
